title: The Bridge That Rose Without Rain
central_conflict: the floating footbridge lifted sharply each afternoon despite steady river levels
decisive_choice: air trapped beneath a repair pontoon expanded in the afternoon heat
resolution: vented the pontoon safely and installed a pressure relief fitting
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the floating footbridge lifted sharply each afternoon despite steady river levels before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they added ballast but the bridge still rose unevenly; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized air trapped beneath a repair pontoon expanded in the afternoon heat; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they vented the pontoon safely and installed a pressure relief fitting, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
